name: submit_video_translation
description:
Translate the spoken language of an existing project video into another language: translated dubbing that preserves the original voice character, optional lip-sync, and translated subtitles. Produces a NEW video asset; the source stays in the library. Use this for requests like 把这条视频改成说英文 / translate this video to Spanish. Do not use it for generating new footage (video-gen), avatar videos (digital-human), subtitle-only translation, or TTS alone (voice). For lip-synced translation (audioOnly is false or omitted), first transcribe the source, call read_script, read the complete matching library transcript (never substitute partial inspect_asset transcript ranges), and present that actual non-empty source-language text in ChatCut's editable Widget form using one transcript segment per line, following the video-translation Skill. The textarea id must be reviewedSourceTranscript and its actual transcript prefill must use the canonical default attribute, never default-value. Never submit in the same turn that first presents the review Widget. For lip-synced translation, pass reviewedSourceTranscript as the exact complete textarea value returned by the user's Widget submission. The Widget submission is the confirmation gate. Do not reconstruct, summarize, or translate the user's reviewed wording. For audio-only translation (audioOnly=true), keep the existing direct-submit flow: do not require transcript review and omit reviewedSourceTranscript. When provided for lip-sync, this tool combines the reviewed text with the original segment timestamps and uses that confirmed source text for translation. Preserve the Widget line breaks when available; the tool can safely realign ordinary line-break edits. Submit directly when the target language and whether lip-sync is wanted are known, except for the lip-sync transcript-review gate above. Do not ask the user to choose a quality or processing mode. The whole source video is translated and billed by its full duration. To translate only a section, trim/export that section into its own asset first. By default the output length may differ slightly from the source: the translated speech keeps a natural pace (dynamic duration). Pass keepDuration=true to force the original length at some cost to naturalness. ChatCut asks the provider to preserve source resolution and bitrate. Lip-sync may still re-render the picture: transparent WebM, 4K, and high-frame-rate inputs are best-effort and the confirmation card calls this out. Prefer audioOnly=true when the picture must not be lip-synced and transparency preservation matters. Track completion with track_progress using the returned jobId.

If confirmation times out or is cancelled before the user answers, ask the user to retry.

audioOnly.description: Translate the audio only and keep the original picture untouched (no lip-sync). Good for screen recordings or footage without a visible speaker.

enableCaption.description: Burn translated subtitles into the output video.

keepDuration.description: Force the output to match the source duration instead of letting translated speech run at a natural pace.

name.description: Display name for the resulting asset.

reviewedSourceTranscript.description: Required for lip-synced translation (audioOnly=false or omitted): the exact complete source-language transcript returned by the user's editable review Widget, including every user correction. Omit for audioOnly=true.

sourceAssetId.description: Project video asset to translate (UUID or short prefix from browse_assets).

sourceLanguage.description: Source language name. Omit to auto-detect from the video's audio.

speakerCount.description: Number of speakers, when known, to improve voice separation.

targetLanguage.description: Target language name in English, e.g. "English", "Spanish", "Japanese".
